title: TechCrunch Mobility: Uber bets on its former CEO | TechCrunch
summary: Travis Kalanick burst back onto the robotics and mobility scene earlier this year with Atoms — a rebranded holding company atop his ghost kitchen project — and a deal to acquire Anthony Levandowski’s industrial automation startup, Pronto .
